verdicts.reason: Both pull all the copy out of the white card. That leaves an empty white box with two orphaned pink dots in the middle of the graphic band, a large dead white area below it, and 'The Minimalist' and the date pushed into the bottom corner, so the original's centred, framed composition is lost. A sets the date in tiny type wrapped over two lines, and its white frame runs open past the band; B's date is a bit larger and easier to read on three lines and its frame closes, which makes B only marginally less broken.
